mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.`id`) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` = '市级项目' THEN l.`id` END) AS cityCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` = '区级项目' THEN l.`id` END) AS districtCount, AS roadCount FROM `t_land` l LEFT JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` AND WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` IN ('市级项目', '区级项目')

SELECT l.`xmfl` AS projectType, CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` = '市级项目' THEN l.`xzqh` ELSE l.`xzqh2` END AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.`id`) AS value, AS roadCount FROM `t_land` l LEFT JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` AND WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` IN ('市级项目', '区级项目') GROUP BY l.`xmfl`, CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` = '市级项目' THEN l.`xzqh` ELSE l.`xzqh2` END HAVING name IS NOT NULL AND name != '' ORDER BY value DESC, name

SELECT COUNT(1) AS facilityTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.`completed` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedFacilityCount FROM ( SELECT f.`ptxmmc` AS ptxmmc, MAX(CASE WHEN f.`sfjg` = '是' AND COALESCE(f.`sfkg`, '') != '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed FROM `t_land` l JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` AND WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` IN ('市级项目', '区级项目') AND GROUP BY f.`ptxmmc` ) t

SELECT t.`projectType` AS projectType, t.`name` AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.`landId`) AS value, COUNT(DISTINCT t.`ptxmmc`) AS facilityCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.`completed` = 1 THEN t.`ptxmmc` END) AS completedCount FROM ( SELECT l.`xmfl` AS projectType, CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` = '市级项目' THEN l.`xzqh` ELSE l.`xzqh2` END AS name, l.`id` AS landId, f.`ptxmmc` AS ptxmmc, MAX(CASE WHEN f.`sfjg` = '是' AND COALESCE(f.`sfkg`, '') != '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed FROM `t_land` l JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` AND WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` IN ('市级项目', '区级项目') AND GROUP BY l.`xmfl`, CASE WHEN l.`xmfl` = '市级项目' THEN l.`xzqh` ELSE l.`xzqh2` END, l.`id`, f.`ptxmmc` ) t WHERE t.`name` IS NOT NULL AND t.`name` != '' GROUP BY t.`projectType`, t.`name` ORDER BY value DESC, t.`name`
mapper.sql: ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`xjpfsfwc` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS landAcquisition, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`kypfsfwc` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS feasibility, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`csjgspfsfwc` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS preliminaryDesign, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`zjlsqk` = '未落实' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS fund, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`sfkg` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS notStarted, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`sfjg` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS notCompleted, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`sfyj` = '否' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(f.`id`), 0), 0), 2) AS notHandedOver

SELECT CONCAT(#{xmfl}, '-', grouped.district) AS id, grouped.district AS district, #{xmfl} AS projectType,
FROM ( SELECT l.`crzdbh`, CASE WHEN #{xmfl} = '区级项目' THEN l.`xzqh2` ELSE l.`xzqh` END AS district FROM `t_land` l WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` = #{xmfl} ) grouped JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = grouped.`crzdbh` AND WHERE grouped.district IS NOT NULL AND grouped.district != '' GROUP BY grouped.district ORDER BY grouped.district
SELECT DISTINCT l.`xzqh2` AS district FROM `t_land` l WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` = '区级项目' AND l.`xzqh2` IS NOT NULL AND l.`xzqh2` != '' ORDER BY l.`xzqh2`

SELECT l.`id` AS id, l.`crzdbh` AS landNo, COALESCE(NULLIF(l.`dkmc`, ''), l.`crzdbh`) AS plotName, l.`xmfl` AS projectType, COALESCE(l.`xzqh`, '') AS district,
FROM `t_land` l JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` AND WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` IN ('市级项目', '区级项目') GROUP BY l.`id`, l.`xzqh`, l.`dkmc`, l.`crzdbh`, l.`xmfl` ORDER BY notHandedOver DESC, district, l.`crzdbh`

SELECT l.`id` AS id, l.`crzdbh` AS landNo, COALESCE(NULLIF(l.`dkmc`, ''), l.`crzdbh`) AS plotName, #{xmfl} AS projectType, COUNT(f.`id`) AS facilityCount,
FROM `t_land` l JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` AND WHERE l.`del_flag` = 0 AND l.`xmfl` = #{xmfl} AND CASE WHEN #{xmfl} = '区级项目' THEN l.`xzqh2` ELSE l.`xzqh` END = #{district} GROUP BY l.`id`, l.`crzdbh`, l.`dkmc` HAVING COUNT(f.`id`) > 0 ORDER BY notHandedOver DESC, l.`crzdbh`
